capabilities: Sync saved videos, articles, photos, files and recordings into the vault
Download linked video, cover and article media as local attachments
Generate timestamped transcripts with server-side speech-to-text
Write summary notes with key points, highlights and keywords
File notes into month and category folders with tidy names
disambiguation: Not a general WeChat note sync; it only pulls items saved through the 易度随手存 mini program or its iOS Shortcut.
extras: Needs network access; the sync server stores saved items, uploads and covers with stated retention periods, and a self-hosted server URL can be set. Install is manual from the latest release.
problem: Content saved on a phone through WeChat has no direct path into an Obsidian vault, so it must be copied over by hand.
